test_metadata_load: test the metadata_load function that parses YAML frontmatter from a model card file and returns a dictionary
test_metadata_save: test the metadata_save function that writes metadata as YAML frontmatter to a model card file
test_metadata_update: test the metadata_update function that updates model card metadata on a Hugging Face Hub repository
test_repo_card_from_template: test the RepoCard.from_template method that generates a model card from a Jinja2 template with CardData
test_push_to_hub: test the RepoCard.push_to_hub method that uploads a model card README to a Hugging Face Hub repository
